digest.component_or_area: completion evidence policy banking observer and test oracle
propositions: Observer bookkeeping must record first durable bank write of each criterion regardless of source (genuine model record OR policy fallback snapshot), excluding seeded cache seeds.
Test oracle must assert system-level boundedness: durable banking events occur at bounded evidence-response intervals (max gap 3) across all actors, not just voluntary model writes.
Fallback-only transcript (model never records; policy snapshots at [2,5,8,11,14]) must pass the oracle under the new scope.
Genuinely-unbounded transcript (fallback disabled, first bank after >3 evidence responses) must fail the oracle in its final form.
Unit regressions must verify observer records fallback-sourced writes and excludes seeded pre-run cache seeding.
